camera.description: Exact current native-resolution RGB-D source: head for central top-down geometry, front for visible frontal appearance, or a wrist when its current pose supplies useful detail.

text.description: Short visible object or part description, never a simulator identifier.

max_candidates.description: Maximum ranked regions to return, 1 to 3; omit for three. Three is what the grounding service answers per call, so a larger number is refused before the request is sent rather than returned as an error you cannot act on. Close-up previews are capped at the first six across a step: the request window holds 24 images and refuses rather than dropping the oldest. Breadth is not free: three regions cost roughly 479 milliseconds against 244 for one, so raise it from one when you are choosing between instances and leave it otherwise.
